answer: A Sybil-resistant mechanism employs a mesa of verifiable delay attestations, where agents provide periodic, time-stamped commitments to their actions, preventing a single entity from creating multiple identities. This defense mirrors the economic cost of Sybil attacks, where an attacker's expected utility is strictly negative due to the prohibitive capital lockup required to maintain multiple identities, rendering the fable of a single entity controlling multiple identities an economic impossibility.
